Silent Partners

No talking on a job. A hands-only VR heist: your left hand commands Lark, your right commands Rook, and every order is a hand signal.

  • FistFreeze
  • PointGo there
  • Thumbs upDo the job
  • Both palms upPause
  • Two fingersToss a coin (Job 2)

Meta Quest 2, 3, 3S or Pro · hand tracking on · seated · Job 1 about six minutes, Job 2 about ten

Play one-handed, swap hands, re-record any signal in your own hand shape, or turn on Assist. Getting seen rewinds; there's no game over.

Built with Meta's Immersive Web SDK for Meta Quest. No audio files and no 3D models: every sound and shape is made in code. Nothing leaves your headset.
